ops: Define states the problem and customer requirements.
Which chart ranks problem categories by frequency?
A Pareto chart helps prioritize the most frequent categories.
Inspection belongs to which quality cost category?
Appraisal checks whether output meets requirements.
A pull system starts production in response to what?
Pull responds to actual downstream need.
acct: Contribution margin per unit equals what?
Contribution covers fixed costs, then profit.
Work expressed as fully completed units
Equivalent units convert partially finished work into completed-unit terms.
Costs before split-off are called what?
Joint costs arise before products can be identified separately.
Which cost is irrelevant to a process-further decision?
An already incurred joint cost does not change between the alternatives.
law: Identification in a sale connects the contract to what?
Identification designates the goods covered by the contract.
Title concerns ownership; possession is a separate concept.
An economic stake in the goods
An insurable interest reflects a stake that could suffer a loss.
A person can hold goods without owning them
Holding goods and owning goods are different concepts.
comm: Which opening best explains an audience-centered proposal?
The audience problem and proposed benefit
Start with the need the audience recognizes and the benefit.
A clear pitch should end with what?
A specific ask tells listeners what action to take.
Which slide is easiest to follow?
One main idea with supporting evidence
One main idea helps listeners track your point.
Which example best supports a claim?
A concrete result with relevant evidence
Evidence should directly support the claim being made.
lit: La voz que habla en el poema
La voz poética es quien habla; no se debe identificar automáticamente con el autor.
En un análisis de cita, ¿qué debes explicar?
Relaciona la cita con personajes, temas, forma y contexto.
Una obra cuyo autor no se conoce
Anónimo se refiere a la autoría desconocida.
El narrador es la voz que cuenta la historia
El autor es un personaje siempre
El narrador pertenece al discurso de la obra; el autor es la persona que la escribió.
